title: Eval mesh dataset shim and weighted prompt conditioning for stable performance publishing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce an EvalMesh adapter that normalizes heterogeneous dataset formats and applies weighted prompt conditioning so that generated performance profiles are stable, reproducible, and compatible with the existing harness. This ticket covers the dataset shim, prompt weighting semantics, seed preservation, artifact metadata changes, and CI validation for publishable profile artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: EvalMesh adapter ingests at least three dataset formats (jsonl, tsv, parquet) and emits a canonical sample envelope used by the harness
Per-prompt weights are supported and honored by the sampler; weights are recorded in artifact metadata
Seedbank metadata (per-sample seed) is stored to allow deterministic re-runs; running same seed + weights yields <3% median latency variance and identical top-k outputs for deterministic models
Published profile artifacts include dataset fingerprint, prompt conditioning map, runner config and sample-level seeds and are stored under s3://redwood-benchmarks/profiles/<model>/<version>/
CI job validates adapter against three representative datasets and fails the pipeline if sampling distribution drifts >5% compared to baseline
technical_notes: Build EvalMesh as a thin adapter layer that implements the HarnessDataset interface; keep adapter pure function to ease unit testing
Weighted prompt conditioning: introduce a normalized weight field on the sample envelope and implement stratified-sampling sampler that uses weights as relative frequencies
Seedbank: attach deterministic RNG seed per-sample; persist seeds in artifact metadata and expose re-run CLI that accepts --seed-bank path
Compatibility shim: adapter should translate old 'prompt_variants' into weighted envelopes to avoid breaking legacy eval runners
Artifact metadata schema bump: add 'dataset_fingerprint', 'prompt_weights_v1', and 'seedbank_version'; ensure manifest validator compatibility checks during publish
